license: Synthetic test inputs and observed numeric outputs only. No LedFx implementation is vendored.

comparison_policy.gate: Exact, including dynamic gate crossings. The fixed -81/-79 dBFS probes bracket the default -80 dBFS threshold. No tolerance window is silently excluded.
comparison_policy.normalized_rmse: sqrt(mean((candidate-reference)^2)) / sqrt(mean(reference^2)), per fixture segment. All-zero segments require zero candidate values.
comparison_policy.segments: Startup [0,1s), sustained [1s,last 0.5s), release [last 0.5s,end), plus explicit transitions from each fixture.
comparison_policy.events: One-to-one nearest unused match within one frame, after the explicitly declared candidate event_alignment_frames. Zero-reference-event segments require no candidate events.
comparison_policy.phase: Circular distance modulo one, aligned by explicit candidate phase_alignment_frames. Tempo validity for the external oracle is raw aubio BPM > 0, not an invented confidence gate.
comparison_policy.effects: Real reference implementations at 60Hz. RGB channels are numeric linear lighting intensities /255 with no gamma conversion. Keep unclipped pre-transform, transformed pre-clip and clipped final arrays separate.
comparison_policy.candidate: Only production C++ analyzer / Qt HUEScript renderer output. Empty or missing fields fail. Reference self-comparison is only a comparator positive control.
known_divergences: Reference kick cutoff excludes its 97Hz center

trace_protocol.format: One JSON object per line; .jsonl or .jsonl.gz. Header first, followed by exactly frame_count frames.

candidate_header.pcm_sha256: hash of the identical canonical input file
candidate_header.segments: from corpus.json; boundaries are exclusive at end
candidate_header.alignment_explanation: Required for nonzero delay correction; never estimate a favorable shift silently

candidate_frame.volume_raw: clamped reference normalized raw dB level
candidate_frame.preemphasis: 500 floats when gate open, null when closed (frozen processor, not a fake zero hop)
candidate_frame.banks: three objects: centers_hz[24] integers, processed[24], novelty[24], raw_triangles[24], gain float or null before initialization
candidate_frame.tempo_bpm: raw authoritative aubio BPM, zero before acquisition
candidate_frame.tempo_confidence: native aubio confidence (diagnostic, not a boolean validity invention)
candidate_frame.events: monotonic integer counters: onset, tempo, kick, bar_wrap, initial counters zero

runtime.command: Production Qt runner receives {request} JSON path and writes {trace} JSONL path; orchestrator does not supply analysis or rendering.
runtime.header: kind=runtime-header, producer=production-qlc-cpp, diagnostics=bool, profiles=[7,29], effects=[spectrum,energy,scroll,wavelength], duration_s=600, analysis_hz=60, render_hz=50, pending_capacity=integer
runtime.render_row: 30000 rows: time_s, render_ms (four committed renders), blocking_ms, pending_work, rss_bytes, allocations, stale_age_ms, audio_frame (latest sequence), available=true
runtime.analysis_row: 36000 rows, kind=analysis: frame (0..35999), time_s=(frame+1)/60, analysis_ms (production analysis of both subscribed profiles)
runtime.render_kind: kind=render; time_s=(frame+1)/50. Interleave analysis and render rows in source-time order.
runtime.policy: Raw measurement includes diagnostics separately. Preload input bytes; do not time filesystem serialization as production analysis/render work. Candidate replay alone does not replace missing baseline replay.

replay.measurement_boundary: Production C++ PCM processing for both profiles plus four committed Qt HUEScript renders. Input bytes preloaded. No Python analysis or stand-in rendering.
